scope: ONE fixed Ridge challenger; approval is recorded separately in approval.json

validation.issues: exact existing windows; 15th of every month in 2019-2021
validation.restriction: Use only observations with dates <= that issue's cutoff; never refit model/scaler on validation

forecast.design: separate direct model for each target and issue lead
forecast.lead_representation: model index h; target-date calendar features use D+h; no numeric lead feature or recursive predictions

features.notation: D=issue; C=D-7; h in 1..7; T=D+h; z_v(t)=float64(float32(observed v(t)))

ordered_definitions.name: target_annual_sin
ordered_definitions.available: deterministic target date known at D

ordered_definitions.name: target_annual_cos
ordered_definitions.available: deterministic target date known at D

features.rolling_aggregation: math.fsum in float64 over chronological values, divided by window size

preprocessing.scope: one fitted scaler per target/lead pipeline; only that model's 6501 training feature rows
preprocessing.formula: (x_j-mu_j)/s_j; mu and variance fitted on training rows only; variance uses ddof=0
preprocessing.source_precision: quantize historical observations and labels with existing climate_data.climatology.float32; promote to float64 for arithmetic/fitting
preprocessing.label_transform: identity after float32 quantization; physical target units
preprocessing.missing_data_policy: fail on absent, duplicate, noncontiguous, fill or nonfinite data; no imputation, partial rolling windows, interpolation or row dropping
preprocessing.outlier_policy: retain validated extremes and review-flagged observations; no QC features or filtering
preprocessing.prediction_postprocessing: none; retain and report any negative ET0 prediction without clipping

ridge.parameter_policy: fixed before Ridge fitting; no RidgeCV, search, alternate feature sets, early stopping or validation-driven changes

execution.environment_changes: none before approval; record interpreter, OS, package versions and BLAS details at the approved run
execution.repeat_prediction_check: same configuration, no candidate selection; compare within absolute tolerance 1e-10 in the same pinned environment

comparison.climatology: existing research=True 2001-2018, circular 366-day +/-15-slot empirical median; unchanged
comparison.persistence: float64(float32(value of the same target at C=D-7)) repeated for h=1..7
comparison.prediction_slot: q50 is only the existing point-prediction API field; Ridge is not asserted to estimate a calibrated median
comparison.intervals: no Ridge/persistence quantiles or prediction intervals
comparison.success_rule: Report each target separately: lower MAE is the primary comparison; separately report RMSE and absolute bias; improvement=baseline-ridge and percent=100*(baseline-ridge)/baseline for MAE/RMSE
comparison.lead_stability: report all seven lead deltas and number of leads with lower MAE/RMSE; do not infer statistical significance
comparison.interpretation: diagnostic validation only, not independent test performance or production readiness
